subject: Request: Combined trial extension + promo credit + discount for AtlasHealth
body:
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia@atlashealth.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Date: Wed, Mar 18, 2026 at 09:12 AM PDT
Subject: Request: trial extension + promotional credit + discount

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re excited about Redwood and want to pilot the inference latency improvements across two of our product lines, but our security review and internal procurement timelines have pushed our integration start date out by ~6 weeks.

Before we sign anything, procurement is asking whether Redwood can: 1) extend the free trial by 45 days (current trial ends Apr 2), 2) apply a one-time promotional credit to cover initial evaluation tokens (we estimated ~$22k in token consumption for the pilot), and 3) provide a first-year volume discount if we commit to a 12-month Dedicated plan after the pilot.

Can you escalate for executive sign-off on credits + discount? We’re prepared to share a mutual action plan and move quickly if we get confirmation.

Thanks,
Alicia Ramos
Head of Integrations, AtlasHealth
[Attachment: Atlas_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf (PDF - 120KB)]

---
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia@atlashealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, Mar 18, 2026 at 10:04 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Request: trial extension + promotional credit + discount

Hi Alicia —

Really appreciate the clear ask and the MAP. I can get a standard 30-day trial extension and our usual one-time $10k promo credit approved through my quota. The additional credit amount and a first-year commercial discount need exec/finance approval because they’re outside our playbook.

I’m escalating now and looping in finance and my manager. I’ll come back with a firm answer by tomorrow EOD. Can you confirm the desired discount % (ballpark) so I can include it in the request?

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0194

---
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, Mar 18, 2026 at 10:22 AM PDT
Subject: Fwd: AtlasHealth — request for combined trial + credits + discount (exec approval request)\n
Team — forwarding request from AtlasHealth (see attached MAP). Summary:
- Trial extension requested: 45 days (their trial ends Apr 2).
- Promo credit requested: ~$22k one-time to cover pilot token usage.
- Commercial ask: first-year volume discount (they did not give a %; asked us to propose).
- Account: AtlasHealth (mid-market healthcare SaaS, US). Current expected ARR if converted: ~$480k/year on Dedicated with initial ramp.

What I’m proposing for exec approval ask: 1) extend trial 45 days (they’ll sign a simple pilot MOU), 2) one-time promo credit $25k, 3) conditional first-year discount 20% off list if they commit to 12-month Dedicated within 60 days of pilot completion. Conditions: references + success criteria defined in MAP + usage threshold.

Please advise: finance impact, legal constraints, and whether we can approve any of this without escalating to VP. Need a response by EOD tomorrow to keep the procurement window.

Attachments: Atlas_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf, Contract_Redline_v3.docx

Thanks — Jasmine

---
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, Mar 18, 2026 at 12:15 PM PDT
Subject: Re: Fwd: AtlasHealth — request for combined trial + credits + discount (exec approval request)

Jasmine — quick finance take:
- 30-day trial extension: negligible impact, fine.
- $25k promo credit: material but could be justified if we get a 12-mo commitment at scale; needs VP approval for > $20k.
- 20% first-year discount: margin pressure depends on their forecasted token consumption and whether we bill on Dedicated flat-fee or usage. If estimated ARR is $480k list, 20% would be ~$96k revenue hit first-year (gross) *before* cost offsets. We should consider a structured discount: 15% upfront, additional 5% contingent on references + usage targets.

Also confirm whether the credit is refundable/transferable (we treat promo credits as non-refund and tied to deal id). Legal (cc Marcus for contract redlines) needs to approve discount language and termination.

Laura
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

---
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, Mar 18, 2026 at 3:08 PM PDT
Subject: Re: Fwd: AtlasHealth — request for combined trial + credits + discount (exec approval request)

Thanks for the context. My read: strategic mid-market account with reasonable ARR. I’m OK to approve an exception with guardrails. Approval (conditional):
- Trial: approve 45-day extension.
- Promo credit: approve up to $20k one-time (to be applied against usage during the pilot), non-refundable, tied to DEAL-8342.
- Discount: approve a structured discount: 15% first-year guaranteed; additional 5% contingent on references + meeting usage thresholds in MAP (i.e., 2 production integrations, 1 public case study). If legal okays contract language, we can proceed.

Require: signed MOU for the pilot, MAP milestones in HubSpot, and Marcus to confirm CS runbook + success criteria.

I’ll sign off now so Jasmine can communicate to the customer and get signatures.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Sales, Redwood Inference

---
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia@atlashealth.com>, procurement@atlashealth.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, Mar 19, 2026 at 02:08 PM PDT
Subject: Re: Request: trial extension + promotional credit + discount

Hi Alicia — great news. Executive approval granted with conditions below:

What Redwood will provide:
- Trial extension: 45 days (new trial end: May 17, 2026).
- One-time promo credit: $20,000 applied to pilot token/usage billing (non-refundable, tied to DEAL-8342).
- First-year commercial discount: 15% off list for year 1; additional 5% (total 20%) contingent on AtlasHealth meeting MAP milestones (2 production integrations and an agreed public case study).

Conditions:
- Signed pilot MOU (I’ve attached our standard MOU).
- MAP milestones logged to HubSpot and accepted by CS (Marcus/Vivek to confirm).
- Promo credit applied only against pilot usage; any overage billed at standard rates.

Next steps: please review the attached MOU and redlines. If that looks good we’ll send a DocuSign for signatures and push the trial extension and credit to your account immediately on signature.

Attachments: Atlas_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf, Contract_Redline_v3.docx
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8342, https://docusign.net/atlash-8342-sign

Thanks — looking forward to getting you going.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0194

---
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia@atlashealth.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@atlashealth.com
Date: Thu, Mar 19, 2026 at 02:44 PM PDT
Subject: Re: Request: trial extension + promotional credit + discount

Jasmine — this is perfect, thank you. I’ve shared with procurement and legal; they’ll review the MOU and we’ll countersign via DocuSign today if the redlines are small. We accept the conditional structure.

Alicia
Head of Integrations, AtlasHealth

[Attachment: Atlas_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf, Contract_Redline_v3.docx]

---
Notes: internal thread included finance/VP approval; attachments referenced rather than embedded. All internal participants are Redwood employees.
